items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Chern classes of the dual of a finite locally free module as the alternating multiples of the Chern classes of the module itself (statement lines 8519-8528, tag 0FA5). The proof reduces to the case where the module has a filtration by invertible modules by means of the splitting principle and injectivity of pullback, constructs the dual filtration whose successive quotients are the inverses of the original quotients, and then compares the two total Chern classes written as products of linear factors with opposite signs. The construction of the dual filtration is the substance, so the claim is H2.
